title: Bobble Stitch Coaster
description: A textured coaster featuring playful bobble stitches that pop out from the fabric.
expectationText: Learn the satisfying bobble stitch technique while creating a chunky, absorbent coaster. The raised texture also makes it extra effective at catching condensation.

steps.title: Make the foundation
steps.instruction: Chain 18. This gives a coaster about 10 cm square.

steps.title: Row 1 (set-up)
steps.instruction: Double crochet into the third chain from hook and each chain across. Chain 2 and turn.

steps.title: Row 2 (bobble row)
steps.instruction: Double crochet 3, then make a bobble stitch: yarn over and pull up a loop 5 times in the same stitch, yarn over and pull through all 11 loops. Repeat the 3 dc + bobble pattern across.

steps.title: Row 3 (plain)
steps.instruction: Double crochet across. Chain 2 and turn.

steps.title: Repeat texture
steps.instruction: Alternate bobble rows with plain rows until you have 8 rows total.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fasten off and weave in ends. Lightly block with steam to flatten the edges.
